messages:
Anna (Design): Looping in the groupnoticed a weird layout bug on very narrow screens: table rows overlap the left collapsible sidebar when the table has long cell content. Repro on Pixel 4a emulation.
Sam (Product): Oof. Any screenshots or steps?
Anna (Design): Screenshot + repro steps in the ticket: https://img.redwood/mock/table-overlap-sidebar.png. Steps: Reduce viewport to 360px, open sidebar, navigate to Dashboard > Jobs list, expand a row with long job id. Table cell overflows and the sticky row controls get pushed under the sidebar.
Priya (UX): Observed on a user session recording too. Users on small phones were confused and tried to swipe the sidebar away. We should prioritize safe fallback for <=375px.
Leo (Frontend): Thoughts: two options: 1) Force the sidebar to collapse to an icon rail at <=375px and make table full-bleed. 2) Keep sidebar but add clip+ellipsis on long cells and enable row-level action menu to avoid inline controls. Both doable.
Anna (Design): I prefer option 1 for most dashboards so content stays readable. When the sidebar is collapsed, we should surface a clear affordance to re-open it (large hit target, label "Menu").
Sam (Product): Option 1 aligns with our mobile-first goals. But check enterprise customers who expect the left nav for quick pivots. Maybe make it configurable behind a feature flag for Dedicated/Private.
Leo (Frontend): Agree on feature flag. Implementation notes: use CSS vars for breakpoints and a11y: when sidebar collapses, announce with ARIA: `aria-live="polite"` region: "Navigation collapsed". Also add visible focus state for the icon rail.
Priya (UX): Also a copy tweak: change the sidebar collapse tooltip from "Hide nav" to "Collapse navigation" (more explicit). And for the ellipsis truncation, prefer showing full text on long press not hover (mobile).
Anna (Design): Accessibility nits: ensure contrast ratio for collapsed icon labels >=4.5, and add skip-to-content link so keyboard users can bypass nav. Also ensure table headers remain in view when sticky; maybe move action controls into a floating context menu anchored to each row.
Leo (Frontend): Quick CSS snippet to avoid overlap: `.app-shell--sidebar-open .main-content { margin-left: var(--sidebar-width); min-width: calc(100% - var(--sidebar-width)); } .table-cell { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }` Will prototype.
Sam (Product): Next steps: Leo to prototype collapse-to-rail + ellipsis behavior. Anna to mock the collapsed state and menu affordance. Priya to surface any blocked customer sessions. We'll gate flag for enterprise.
DevOps-Bot: Note: created ticket RDC-1176 and attached logs from production mobile sessions.
Anna (Design): Thanks! Ping when prototype is up; I'll run quick contrast and hit-target checks.
Priya (UX): I'll add two short usability checks to the mobile study template: one for discoverability of collapsed nav and one for long-id readability.
Leo (Frontend): Pushing prototype branch today, will link in RDC-1176. :shipit:
